definitions.explanation: a subject taught in Japanese elementary schools that combines drawing, painting, and handcraft activities

examples.japanese: {図画工作|ずがこうさく}の{時間|じかん}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like arts and crafts class.

examples.japanese: {図画工作|ずがこうさく}で{紙粘土|かみねんど}の{作品|さくひん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: We made paper clay creations in arts and crafts.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{図画工作|ずがこうさく}では{絵|え}を{描|か}いたり、ものを{作|つく}ったりする{活動|かつどう}をする。
examples.english: In elementary school arts and crafts, students do activities like drawing pictures and making things.

notes:
Composed of {図画|ずが} (drawing, painting) + {工作|こうさく} (crafts, construction). Often abbreviated as {図工|ずこう} in everyday conversation. This is a required subject in Japanese elementary schools, covering both visual arts (drawing, painting, printmaking) and craft activities (clay work, woodworking, paper crafts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}: arts and crafts class
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}の{時間|じかん}: arts and crafts period
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}の{作品|さくひん}: arts and crafts project/work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {図工|ずこう}: arts and crafts — the common abbreviation used by students and parents
- {美術|びじゅつ}: fine arts — the art subject in middle school and high school (replaces {図画工作|ずがこうさく})
- {工作|こうさく}: crafts — the hands-on making component alone
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}: technical arts — a middle school subject covering woodworking, metalwork, and technology
